status: Called in by Secretary of State
decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_:
2002 Application No. P011688 and P011689

Consent for:
A side extension at basement and ground floor levels was granted permission, to provide a garage at basement level and kitchen above. This extension is subservient to the main house as it is set back from the building line and lowered with the kitchen floor level 1200mm below the ground floor level of the main house. It included a clerestory roof over the kitchen area to provide top light to the space.

2017 Application No: P2017/0749/FUL (Householder Planning Application) and P2017/0851/LBC (Listed Building Consent Application)

Consent for: 
Removal of existing raised roof with clerestory windows above side extension, and replacement with a fixed, flat roof light with lead upstand. Insertion of conservation rooflights over existing first floor flat roof. Internal works including creation of new opening to ground floor WC from entrance hall, and removal and replacement of timber stud wall at first floor level. 

2024 Application No: P2024/1717/LBC and No: P2024/1716/FUL
Listed Building Consent and Planning Consent for the over-cladding of existing concrete front steps with Yorkstone and repaving of front path and side steps with Yorkstone. Replacement of existing concrete pillar caps with Yorkstone to match new steps. Internal alterations.

2025 Listed Building Consent Application No. P2025/3183/LBC
Ceiling repair works.
